SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE Sp. Br. REGISTRY No. 372 Div. 14 Station 45 Date Sept. 14 1940）

Subject: Farewell parties in honour of Mr. Y. Miura, Japanese Consul-General.

Made by J. S. Kamashita Forwarded by J. S. I. Logan

A farewell luncheon party is scheduled to be held at the Astor House Hotel by some 50 prominent members of the local branch of the Japanese Navy Association, at 12 noon, September 16th, in honour of Mr. Y. Miura, Japanese Consul-General, who was recently promoted to the position of Minister to Mexico and is expected to leave here shortly.

A farewell dinner party sponsored by Mr. C. Fukuda, president of the Japanese Residents' Corporation, Mr. Y. Hanawa, manager of M.B.M., and Mr. Fu Siau-en, Mayor of Shanghai City Government, will take place in the Nippon Club, Boone Road, at 7 p.m., same day, at which Mr. Miura will be the guest of honour. A large number of leading members of the local Japanese community including high military and naval officers are expected to attend the party.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别支部 登记号 372 第14分区 第45巡捕房 日期 1940年9月14日）

事由：为日本总领事三浦先生举行的告别宴会。

由 J. S. Kamashita 撰写，经 J. S. I. Logan 转呈

日本海军协会上海分会约50名知名成员定于9月16日中午12时，在礼查饭店（Astor House Hotel）举行告别午宴，以 honour 日本总领事三浦（Y. Miura）先生。三浦先生最近被擢升为驻墨西哥公使，预计不久将离沪。

由日本居留民团团长福田（C. Fukuda）先生、M.B.M. 经理花轮（Y. Hanawa）先生以及上海市政府市长傅筱庵（Fu Siau-en）先生发起的告别晚宴，将于同日晚上7时在布恩路（Boone Road）的日本俱乐部（Nippon Club）举行，三浦先生将作为主宾出席。预计当地日本社群的大量头面人物，包括高级陆海军军官，将出席该宴会。
